title: Sabah Half Marathon 2026 Review: JomRun Brings a 21K to Borneo
seo_title: Sabah Half Marathon 2026 Review | JomRun Borneo Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun 2026: December 13 in Sabah, Malaysian Borneo. A 21K and 10K from Malaysia's leading race registration platform — registration open.
dek: Set for 13 December 2026 in Sabah, Malaysian Borneo, this JomRun-powered half marathon brings Malaysia's leading race registration platform to East Malaysia. 21K and 10K distances with registration open. Here's what to expect from Borneo's newest half marathon.
verdict: The Sabah Half Marathon Powered by JomRun brings Malaysia's most active race registration platform to Borneo for a half marathon (21K) and 10K event. Sabah is one of Southeast Asia's great adventure destinations — Mount Kinabalu, orangutans, and the Coral Triangle's best diving — and a December road race here offers a genuine destination-race proposition. JomRun's involvement means a familiar registration experience and the platform's established runner communications. Registration is open. Suits runners who want a Malaysian half marathon with Borneo's adventure-tourism infrastructure built in.

sections.heading: The Platform: JomRun in Borneo
paragraphs: JomRun is Malaysia's leading race registration and discovery platform, powering dozens of events across the peninsula and East Malaysia. [1] A JomRun-powered race comes with a standardised registration process, clear communications, and a digital race pack — runner's guide, bib number, and results all handled through the platform. For a regional race in Sabah, that platform backing adds a layer of operational reliability.

sections.heading: The Destination: Sabah, Malaysian Borneo
paragraphs: Sabah is one of the most biodiverse places on Earth — home to Mount Kinabalu (Southeast Asia's highest peak), the Kinabatangan River's orangutans and pygmy elephants, and the world-class dive sites of Sipadan. [1] A half marathon here is as much about the post-race recovery as the race itself. December falls within Sabah's northeast monsoon, which brings rain to the coastal areas — expect humid conditions regardless.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a Borneo half marathon with JomRun's platform reliability and Sabah's adventure-tourism infrastructure, this is a bookable option. Registration is open now. The 2026 edition is set for 13 December in Sabah. [1]
